watchlist.thesis_summary: Dominant weak-leg node in the financials-versus-growth-tech rotation [AR-5], appearing across at least six correlation breakdown pairs at 4.0–5.2σ (QQQ:WFC [CR-307], WFC:XLK [CR-348], META:WFC [CR-234], SOXX:WFC [CR-325], SMH:WFC [CR-321]). [SA-FIN-1] records a 3.15σ volume event on a −3.52 price move; [AR-2] characterizes it as continuation of multi-week structural NIM compression under the inverted curve, not single-session flush. [SA-FIN-TC-1] flags it as a three-source distillation-convergent momentum short, and the CPI print at May 12 12:30Z [QR-1, SA-FIN-4] is the binary resolution catalyst within 41–48 hours, with the asymmetric repricing biased to the soft-print side.

Synchronized 52-week-high breakout alongside AMD, INTC, QCOM with ADX 38–61 [SA-TECH-1], and a 20-day return of +77.56% versus NVDA's +14.09% on 1.53× baseline volume [AR-3] — elevated but not extreme, consistent with sustained institutional accumulation rather than a short-squeeze unwind. The 1-day SOXX→QQQ lead-lag is overdue at 2.10σ [CR-14], implying the semis breakout has not yet transmitted into broad tech. The conviction limiter is the unidentified differentiating DRAM/HBM demand catalyst that separates MU from NVDA — [AR-3] flags this gap as load-bearing and unresolved due to tool unavailability.

Energy services-versus-E&P ordering inversion with second-source corroboration: [SA-ENERGY-1] places BKR at the 67th intra-sector 20-day percentile and SLB at the 100th, while E&P-heavy OXY/APA/DVN trail by −6.3% to −2.4% — anomalous against the canonical Hormuz-disruption sequencing. [SA-ENERGY-4] and [SA-ENERGY-TC-1] independently surface a BofA Buy reiteration on BKR as a non-technical second source, and [SA-ENERGY-TC-1] frames the services premium as direct pricing of Middle East operational exposure. The asymmetric downside is the 17.5%-by-May-31 US-Iran nuclear deal probability that would sharply compress the services premium — a discrete falsification path rather than diffuse risk.

ADX=61.26 is the strongest trend reading in the entire universe [SA-TECH-1], with INTC participating in the synchronized semis breakout alongside AMD, MU, QCOM. Concurrent tier-3 headline of an Apple-Intel chip deal [SA-TECH-2, SA-TECH-TC-2] could supply a fundamental leg, but rests on a single unconfirmed source — technical conviction is meaningfully higher than fundamental conviction, and the AAPL-isolate pattern across [CR-16], [CR-17], [CR-20] is not yet resolvable to confirm or deny that deal. Conviction held at 2 explicitly because the fundamental leg is unverified rather than weak.
